description: Read one document of the Italian tax practice (prassi) with its text in slices. Give the id (uuid from it-prassi_search or it-prassi_lookup) or the natural key tipo + numero + anno (the key can match several rows, e.g. a circolare and its English version). Returns the extremes (ente, struttura, tipo, numero, anno, data, oggetto, source_url), the text slice (offset 0-based, length 1..50000 characters, default 20000), text_length, truncated and next_offset (the offset of the next slice, null at the end), estrazione (testo = PDF text layer, ocr = local OCR) and the norm references riferimenti [{descrizione, articolo, comma, norma_urn}] (norma_urn only when resolved; best-effort). No row means the document is not in the corpus. Prassi is the administration's interpretation, not a source of law. Example: {"id": "3f2c...", "offset": 20000}.
